description: This plot illustrates the "Hidden State Mean" across different layers, comparing three distinct conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 1. There are three lines plotted, all without markers. The first line, labeled "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," is a blue dashed line. It begins at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, maintains a relatively steady, low value with minor fluctuations up to layer 17 (where it is around 0.4), rises to approximately 0.9 at layer 19, and then exhibits a sharp increase, reaching approximately 2.6 at layer 21 and peaking at roughly 4.3 at layer 23. The second line, labeled "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," is an orange dotted line. It starts near 0 at layer 0 and remains steady and close to 0 across the entire x-axis, ending at approximately 0.1 at layer 23. The third line, labeled "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," is a green solid line. Similar to the orange line, it begins near 0 at layer 0 and maintains a steady, flat trend near 0 throughout the plot, also ending at approximately 0.1 at layer 23.
